author: Seung Wook
problem: times lists, in order, the minute of the day each photo at a wedding was taken. A new album starts whenever more than gap minutes pass between two consecutive photos. Return how many albums the photos fill.
bug_description: Starts the album count at 0 instead of 1, so it counts the breaks between albums rather than the albums themselves.

comments.accurate: Number of albums, starting a new one after each long pause between photos
comments.wrong_behavior: Number of album breaks: one for each long pause between photos
comments.wrong_location: Album count verified; check a pause exactly gap minutes long stays in the same album
